name: internetless-reading-v1-offline-fix-20261010
description: OFFLINE FIX (Oct 10 2026): SW v15 precaches /doc shell + /doc fetch branch with offline fallback; saved-readings index page; readings register in saved-pages list. Root cause: v14 never cached the reader shell. Browserbase verified online render + index + SW control; flight-mode retest pending owner-side.
content:
{
  "mission": "HARZ Internetless Reading v1 \u2014 offline fix (GATE 4 retest block). Rabiu's phone flight-mode test failed Oct 10 ~00:13: article saved to IndexedDB online (LIVE badge verified by owner screenshots) but offline the /doc shell did not load, browser fell back to home; 'saved pages' list showed nothing because it only tracks /page?url= viewer entries.",
  "root_cause": "Service worker v14 precached only '/', manifest, icons. The /doc reader shell was never precached, and SW registration on the first visit likely completed after the /doc navigation, so the exact URL was never cached either. Offline: no shell to run -> nothing could read IndexedDB -> honest fallback home. Additionally the app's saved-pages index has no knowledge of doc readings.",
  "fix_browser_v4": "(1) SW v15 (cache harz-browser-v15): precaches /doc reader shell at install; fetch handler gets a /doc branch (network-first, on failure serves exact-URL cache, then the precached shell, then offline notice); add-saved message handler so saved readings register in the saved-pages index. (2) /doc page: saved readings now post add-saved to the SW; /doc with no params renders an offline index of everything stored on the device (IndexedDB cursor, links per doc); status bar shows SW control state. Wave key and reader storage laws unchanged.",
  "correction": "Desk initially refused to deploy citing Base44 integration credit exhaustion; Rabiu challenged it; verified live: deploys go to Cloudflare directly by script and do not consume Base44 integration credits \u2014 all deploys tonight succeeded at 100.4/100. Desk error, owned and corrected.",
  "browser_verification": "Browserbase real-browser PASS: /doc?id=1055000 renders full 14,424-char article LIVE + saved on device; /doc (no params) renders Saved readings index listing both stored docs (id:1055000 full + sid:0 preview) with CACHED badge; status bar shows SW on; article re-render after navigation confirms SW-controlled load. Screenshot captured. Honest pending label: actual network-off (flight mode) test remains owner-side on the Infinix \u2014 SW offline branch is deterministic but untested against a real radio.",
  "owner_retest": "1. Open https://harz-browser.harz.workers.dev/doc?id=1055000 online, verify LIVE. 2. Open https://harz-browser.harz.workers.dev/doc to see it listed under Saved readings. 3. Airplane mode. 4. Reopen either link, expect OFFLINE badge + full text. 5. Kill browser, reopen offline, still readable. 6. Report result."
}
